mapper_a_opus.reason: The alias wait could be satisfied by an unrelated request, so the test assumed an ordering between its own wait and the target query that was not guaranteed.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The cy.wait alias is consumed by an unrelated matching request, so the test's own wait ordering assumption breaks.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Ambiguous locator (two file inputs) plus an input action that never reached the real onChange handler are both target-resolution failures, which the F5 note assigns to F2.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Ambiguous two-input locator is F2, but the second mode (setInputFiles not reaching React state) has no clean code; F2 is the least bad.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The click/type landed on fixed chrome instead of the intended input, and a keystroke or click that never reaches its target is F2.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The click or type never landed on the intended input because fixed chrome covered it, which the table assigns to F2 rather than F5.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A whole-app remount replaced the filled input with a fresh node, a re-render window where the test acted on a stale element.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The filled input node was replaced by a re-render/remount, a stale-element window, with the toPass retry masking it.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The backend did succeed after 20-27 s and the defect was a 20 s wait budget near that slow successful response, fixed by waiting longer on the response.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The 20s wait budget was shorter than a slow but successful 20-27s response, so the defect is the wait budget.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A popup left open by an earlier test was picked up as the target, so failures depended on test order.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: A popup left open by an earlier test in the same browser leaked state, making failures order dependent.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The Bootstrap fade transition removed the element before the re-query observed it, a transient-element window.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The element was mid fade transition and then removed from the DOM, so the re-query read inside a transition window.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A non-waiting isHidden read sampled the table before its rows rendered, a one-shot read inside a render window.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: A non-waiting isHidden() read sampled a table that was not yet rendered.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Readiness did eventually arrive but took 2-4x longer under reduced motion and exceeded the test timeout; the real cause is a product CSS performance cascade that no code describes well.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Transitions cascading under reduced motion slowed readiness past the timeout; nearest is animation/transition in progress, with F8 as the reduced-motion environment angle.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The assertion that the input stays empty ran before the save the test itself triggered had been processed and normalized to zero.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The assertion ran before the save the test itself triggered was processed, racing the save response.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The write was rejected as unauthenticated because the auth token handshake had not settled; the mechanism is a product-side auth/session race rather than a test ordering assumption.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The database write raced ahead of the auth token handshake, an async ordering assumption between separate processes.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The inputs were rendered but not yet interactive until page script enabled them, closest to rendered-but-inert, though not an SSR hydration case.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Typing happened during the window before the page script enabled the inputs, a not-yet-ready render state.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A previous test's context disposal wedged the shared browser process, so the next test in the worker stalled.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: A previous test's leftover WebGL renderer wedged the browser for the next context in the same worker.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Server-rendered content was visible but clicks did nothing until hydration, fixed with a hydration marker.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Server-rendered content was visible but inert until hydration, so the click opened no dialog.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Keystrokes were dropped while the editor was re-rendering, so Save never enabled; a re-render window rather than a wait budget.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Keystrokes were dropped during editor re-renders, a re-render window, leaving Save disabled.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The static server's small backlog occasionally reset connections, failing a module import, which is a network dependency failure.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Intermittent connection resets from the test static server broke the module graph, a network-level failure.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Clicking during the menu's enter transition left an invisible mounted menu catching pointer events, a transition race.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Clicking within an interrupted enter transition left an invisible menu mounted that still caught pointer events.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The dispatched event had no effect because the app's listener was not yet attached after mount, matching rendered-but-inert listeners, though not an SSR hydration case.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The dispatch was queued before the app's listener was attached, an ordering assumption within the test's own steps.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A read at the JS call site ran before the queued record step had produced its value, a command-queue ordering assumption.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: A JS read fired before the cy queue had run the earlier record step, a command-queue ordering race.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The assertion on the dropdown's disappearance did not check the intended outcome, compounded by leftover data matching a substring name.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The assertion checked the wrong thing (over-broad), compounded by leftover state matching rows; no single code covers both.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The id selector matched both the visible main and an offscreen preload copy, an ambiguous selector.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The id selector matched two elements (strict mode violation) because of an offscreen duplicate.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The test assumed navigation had completed loading when its URL assertion passed at commit, then resized the viewport across that lifecycle boundary.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The test assumed navigation commit meant the document had finished loading before resizing the viewport.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A hidden duplicate element made the class selector match two elements.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The class selector matched two elements because of a hidden duplicate button.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Keyboard traversal started before React hydration finished on server-rendered HTML.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Keyboard traversal began before React hydration finished on server-rendered HTML.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The test navigated before the app's own location replace landed, assuming an order the app's async steps do not guarantee.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The test's navigation was issued before the app's own location replace landed and was overwritten.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The helper acted on the wrong element (adding a new row instead of opening row 1's cell), closest to a targeting failure though no selector error was involved.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The selector targeted a newly appended row instead of the existing row whose cell lacks an input.

mapper_a_opus.reason: During a screen transition the test acted on the old screen, whose popover unmounted when the new screen committed.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: The helper did not wait for the account screen transition, so the next step acted on the old screen that was then replaced.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A fixed 300 ms sleep sampled state instead of awaiting the native fullscreenchange outcome that does arrive on its own.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: A fixed 300ms sample was used instead of a retrying wait or the event, a wait strategy defect.
